rules.statement: o_tx_ready must be 1 (its idle value) while i_rst_n = 0, since no handshake is possible during reset.

rules.condition: receiving a frame after start detection at T0
rules.statement: The receiver samples the middle of each bit H = floor(N/2) edges after T0, then every N edges.

rules.condition: stop bit sampled at edge M
rules.statement: o_rx_valid is delivered at V = M + 2, where M is the sample edge of i_rxd and 2 is the synchronizer latency.

rules.condition: held byte is taken at the same edge at which a new byte completes
rules.statement: The new byte is loaded and no overrun occurs.

rules.condition: after a frame error with the line still low
rules.statement: A new start requires a 1-to-0 transition on i_rxd, so a break yields only one byte.
The synchronizer resets to 1; a low i_rxd at reset release is detected as a start bit.
o_rx_data and o_rx_frame_err keep the last loaded values, and are 0 after reset.
The frame is abandoned, o_txd goes to 1 at once and the byte is lost.
The frame-error flag of a dropped byte is not reported.
An elaboration error should be raised for illegal parameter values; this is not verified.
CFG-ODD (5) and CFG-WIDE (1024) are simulated; CFG-MAX (65535) is not simulated and is covered by elaboration and synthesis only.
No area budget is required for GF180MCU; area is reported, not checked.
The 50 MHz target applies at the slow corner (GF180MCU SS, 125 C, 4.5 V).
